transcript: Alright, so something happened this morning that left me befuddled. So I met this lady, right? Basically, she was starting a new job today and she was asking for directions. I was like, cool, gave her directions. I also told her congratulations and good luck on her first day at her new job. Then I asked her, I said, so how did you apply for your job? Did you do it online? She was like, no. Just walked in there, let her know I wanted to work. They sent me out for a drug test and then once I passed, you know, they got me started. I said, ooh, that sounds like a blessing. How much did they start off with? She said, $13 an hour. First thing in my head was, oh, I wouldn't work for that company. That company ain't shit. First and foremost, in this economical climate, unless you're paying somebody at least $20 an hour to $23 an hour, you shouldn't even be asking them to even take a damn drug test. So you're going to underpay me and then require me to go take a drug test for you to underpay me? Bitch.
